answer: Farms must cash out, so tax the harbor where loot pools. A transfer from an address under 20 epochs old pays a fee of 1% x (N-1), capped at 90%, where N is how many distinct young addresses paid that same recipient this epoch. One newcomer paying a friend: 0%. A farm draining 100 clones into one basalt cold wallet: 90% burns. Splitting into ten lagoon wallets still costs 9% each, and those wallets must age 20 epochs before re-sweeping. A merchant wanting many young payers locks a 5,000 POA bond, slashed if its payers prove to be one farm. Assumes clone loot is roughly equal per head.
